item.title: Researchers Use Dynamic Digital Radiography to Quantify Functional Outcomes After Total Shoulder Arthroplasty
item.description: tim.hodson Mon, 03/02/2026 - 13:13 March 2, 2026 — Emory Healthcare researchers, led by Dr. Eric R. Wagner, recently published a study comparing two well-established treatment options for cuff-intact glenohumeral osteoarthritis in the shoulder. Using Konica Minolta's Dynamic Digital Radiography (DDR), the team evaluated which surgical technique most effectively restores native shoulder biomechanics.
